title: The completed constant-to-supported diagonal unit
statement: Let l be prime, Y a scheme, W=P1(Y) times_Y P1(Y), and i:P1(Y)→W its diagonal. The completed coefficient map of [det-prop-diagonal-tower-limit], under the ordinary inverse-image/direct-image adjunction, gives a ring-sheaf map Z_l,W→i_*Z_l,P1(Y). Define completedSupportedUnit as Mathlib SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit for its underlying ring map. Its codomain is diagonalCompletedSource, with exactly the action through that coefficient map, and its source is the completed coefficient unit on W. On every pro-etale chart its value is the actual ring map on sections; in particular one maps to one.
